title: Terrain workshop — editable tunnels
goal: Keep the accepted Raise/Lower brush. Test creating one tunnel, moving that same tunnel, and adjusting its entrance, exit and radius without leaving extra cuts.
changes: New: grab either tunnel centre point to drag/select that end; click a surface to place it. A green radius circle follows the target wall. Loading now shows this briefing, progress and a screenshot. Hands and gun are hidden while editing.
controls:
Raise/Lower: hold LMB on ground. RMB + WASD: fly; Space/Ctrl: up/down. Wheel: zoom; Shift-wheel: brush size.
Tunnel: Create ONE, then click entrance. Grab an orange entrance/cyan exit centre to drag and select it; click elsewhere on terrain to place that end. Focus tunnel finds its handles. Move whole tunnel moves both ends. Ctrl snaps exit heading; Alt-click targets the far exit surface. Esc cancels.
F8: mark BEGIN/END around a slow operation. F3: chunks. F1: edit/play. F2: briefing. Save explicitly to retain terrain edits.
